summary: Woman's home near Fish Creek Falls Road in Steamboat Springs was entered ~1 a.m. by a black bear that forced a sliding glass door off its track; when she tried to chase it out, it struck her face, causing cuts; she drove herself to a hospital, was treated for facial injuries and released.
location: Home near Fish Creek Falls Road, Steamboat Springs
notes: CPW 8/19/2026 release (dual incident release); hair samples collected for DNA; trap set.
